title: Platinum Rewards Card: Elite Business Credit Card Application
summary: This document outlines eligibility and underwriting for the Platinum Rewards Card (Elite Business Credit Card), requiring a $765 minimum personal credit score and, for established businesses, a 77 PAYDEX business credit score. It specifies carried-balance APR at 16.99% and credit limits from $75,000 to $400,000, plus application steps via an online dashboard or commercial lending specialist and guidance for supporting documentation.
faqs: What minimum personal credit score and business credit standard (PAYDEX) are required to apply?
What carried-balance APR applies if my balance is not paid in full?
What credit limit range ($75,000–$400,000) can I request or be approved for?
What documents and business details do I need to prepare before submitting the application?
How do I submit the application—through an online dashboard or with a commercial lending specialist?
How does underwriting evaluate my application and could my requested limit be adjusted?
keywords: Recent business financials and bank references
